blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Bam Aquino explained early Wednesday morning that the expected Philippine rocket launch in early 2027 is to collect beneficial data for various sectors, including agriculture, environment, disaster monitoring, and national security. Aquino, who authored the Republic Act No. 11363, known as the Philippine Space Act, explained as he defended the P1 billion budget of the Philippine Space Agency (PhilSA). “[Space data] can be beneficial… To be specific, meron siyang application sa agriculture, environmental protection and monitoring, natural resource management, disaster risk reduction, national security among others,” Aquino explained.
